where: Lowleaf Hollow (the glowmoss forest town) and Gloamwood Dell
mood: A dim-green glowmoss forest where every dewdrop catches cyan light — Lydian wonder, enchanted and curious.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
G Lydian mode with the raised fourth
glassy bell and celesta lead, slow wondering phrases that hang on the raised fourth
sparkling glassy bell arpeggios of slow broken chords
breathy soft pad and warm low synth bass with long notes
barely-there percussion, a soft tap per bar and dewdrop ticks
enchanted bioluminescent forest town, dewy wonder, a hush full of soft glow

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a shimmering rising sparkle on glassy bells climbs through the Lydian raised fourth and blooms into a held glowing chord, the forest lighting up as you enter}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the wondering bell melody: it floats up, hangs on the raised fourth, then resolves home luminously; slow sparkling arpeggios underneath, very hummable}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again with a soft wooden flute counter-melody weaving beneath it, lanterns strung between the trunks, a little fuller and warmer}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a hushed turn to E minor for the grey, dimmed moss-bed at the hollow's heart, the arpeggios thin, a low flute sighs over the pad, then the bells climb back toward the light}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the glowing bell melody returns in full wonder; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
